description: You are an architectural drafter preparing as-built documentation for a recently constructed 2-car garage. Open the original design drawing at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf' in LibreCAD. Field inspections have revealed that the actual built conditions differ from the design: the garage door rough opening width was field-adjusted, one wall intersection was reinforced with an additional stud bay, and the builder added a utility sink rough-in that was not in the original plans. Prepare this drawing as an official as-built record drawing by: (1) creating a layer structure appropriate for as-built documentation, distinguishing original design from field-verified conditions, (2) adding an as-built status stamp to the drawing, (3) documenting at least two specific field changes with descriptive notes on an appropriate markup layer, and (4) adding any other as-built annotations that a construction manager would expect on a record drawing. Do not remove original entities. Save the completed as-built drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_asbuilt.dxf'.
